extension.name: Sauvidya PACE Framework
extension.description: Principal accessibility / capacity / engagement layer for A2A orchestrators.

agent_card_payload_schema.description:
PACE-specific fields contributed to an A2A AgentCard.

Validators detect PACE support by the presence of an entry in
``capabilities.extensions[]`` whose ``uri`` equals
``PACE_EXTENSION_URI``. The body of that entry SHOULD deserialize
to this model.

version.description: PACE protocol semver this agent implements.
version.title: Version

pcp_endpoint.description: HTTPS URL where this agent exchanges PrincipalCapabilityProfile (PCP) metadata with the principal's PACE orchestrator. The endpoint MUST authenticate the orchestrator; PCPs are never fetched by remote A2A agents.
pcp_endpoint.title: Pcp Endpoint

aic_endpoint.description: HTTPS URL pattern (with ``{principal_id}`` placeholder) where the AdaptiveInteractionContract for a given principal is fetched. Returns the orchestrator's currently bound AIC.
aic_endpoint.title: Aic Endpoint

violation_notice_endpoint.description: HTTPS URL where peer orchestrators POST PACEViolationNotice messages targeting this agent. REQUIRED so the violation broadcast loop has a destination per orchestrator.
violation_notice_endpoint.title: Violation Notice Endpoint

supports_active_assessment.description: True if this agent implements active ConsentCapacityCheck (challenge-response). False means it falls back to passive interpolation only.
supports_active_assessment.title: Supports Active Assessment

supported_modalities.description: PrimaryChannel values this agent can drive (e.g. ['voice', 'text']). validate_channels checks every channel of an InteractionModality, primary and fallback, against this list.
supported_modalities.title: Supported Modalities

supported_languages.description: ISO 639-1 codes this agent can converse in. Used to fail fast when an AIC requires a language the agent cannot speak.
supported_languages.title: Supported Languages

guardian_escalation_endpoint.description: HTTPS URL the agent uses to escalate to a registered guardian. REQUIRED when the agent serves principals whose PCP indicates guardian_required decision_capacity.
guardian_escalation_endpoint.title: Guardian Escalation Endpoint

agent_card_payload_schema.title: AccessibilityServiceRef

wire_artefacts.name: PrincipalCapabilityProfile
wire_artefacts.description: Read-only PCP copy the principal's PACE orchestrator delivers to an agent before it may interact (PCP-1, IM-1).

schema.description:
Declares a principal's interaction capabilities.

This is the communication contract between the principal (or guardian)
and every agent in the network.

language.description: At least one language with fluency score
language.title: Language

adaptations_required.description: Derived adaptations: voice_primary, language:te, max_options:2, etc.
adaptations_required.title: Adaptations Required

correction_of.description: Version ID this corrects, if any (PCP-2 forward correction)
correction_of.title: Correction Of

schema.title: PrincipalCapabilityProfile

wire_artefacts.name: AdaptiveInteractionContract
wire_artefacts.description: The orchestrator's currently bound AIC for a principal; the URL carries a {principal_id} placeholder.

EnforcementAction.description:
The action the issuing orchestrator applied locally and is asking
peers to mirror.

Names align with the strings used in ``ViolationPolicy`` defaults
(``"block_agent + notify_guardian"`` etc.) but split into structured
enum values so peers can apply enforcement without parsing.
EnforcementAction.title: EnforcementAction

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the principal, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. valid_time_windows and sundown_block are the principal's local times in this zone, whatever clock the agent runs on. If the principal travels, the guardian issues a new contract version.
timezone.title: Timezone

min_language_fluency.description: IM-2 floor: absent a language pin in the PCP's adaptations_required, an agent may only use a language the PCP lists at or above this fluency. Guardian-configurable reference default, not a clinical cutoff.
min_language_fluency.title: Min Language Fluency

NonResponsePolicy.description:
AIC-3: what an agent does when the principal does not answer.

No retry inside the window of the unanswered attempt; at most
``max_retries`` retries; after ``escalate_after`` non-responses, stop
and escalate to the guardian.

retry_delay.description: A retry waits for the next valid time window.
retry_delay.title: Retry Delay

escalate_after.description: Non-responses after which the agent escalates instead of retrying.
escalate_after.title: Escalate After

NonResponsePolicy.title: NonResponsePolicy

ViolationPolicy.description:
What happens when an agent breaks the contract (AIC-4).

Each field is the list of actions for one kind of violation. The
paper's ``"block_agent + notify_guardian"`` string form is accepted.

on_modality_contract_violation.description: AIC-5: an agent's plan steps outside the contract.
on_modality_contract_violation.title: On Modality Contract Violation

ViolationPolicy.title: ViolationPolicy

schema.description: Binding agreement governing how all agents interact with this principal.
schema.title: AdaptiveInteractionContract

wire_artefacts.name: GuardianNotification
wire_artefacts.description: What the guardian receives when the contract's policy says notify_guardian (AIC-4): the agent, the rule, a plain-language summary, both clocks, the actions taken and the next allowed contact. Carries no capacity data (CCC-2).

EnforcementAction.description:
The action the issuing orchestrator applied locally and is asking
peers to mirror.

Names align with the strings used in ``ViolationPolicy`` defaults
(``"block_agent + notify_guardian"`` etc.) but split into structured
enum values so peers can apply enforcement without parsing.
EnforcementAction.title: EnforcementAction

ViolationType.description: Which AIC clause was breached. Mirrors ViolationPolicy keys.
ViolationType.title: ViolationType

guardian_id.description: The approving guardian, when the contract names one.
guardian_id.title: Guardian Id

agent_id.description: The agent that broke the contract.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

principal_local_time.description: When it happened on the principal's clock, with her zone.
principal_local_time.title: Principal Local Time

guardian_local_time.description: When it happened on the guardian's clock, when the orchestrator knows it.
guardian_local_time.title: Guardian Local Time

next_step.description: What happens next without the guardian doing anything.
next_step.title: Next Step

wire_artefacts.name: PACEViolationNotice
wire_artefacts.description: Signed one-hop broadcast of an AIC violation to peer orchestrators (V-1, V-2, V-3).

EnforcementAction.description:
The action the issuing orchestrator applied locally and is asking
peers to mirror.

Names align with the strings used in ``ViolationPolicy`` defaults
(``"block_agent + notify_guardian"`` etc.) but split into structured
enum values so peers can apply enforcement without parsing.
EnforcementAction.title: EnforcementAction

ViolationType.description: Which AIC clause was breached. Mirrors ViolationPolicy keys.
ViolationType.title: ViolationType

schema.description:
One-hop broadcast that an AIC violation has occurred.

Issued by the detecting orchestrator; consumed by peer
orchestrators bound by the same AIC for the same principal. Per
CCC-2, the notice MUST NOT carry principal speech, response text,
or any capacity_signal value; only structured facts and digests.

principal_id.description: The principal under whose AIC this violation occurred. Receivers use this to scope the block to peers of this principal only (V-3).
principal_id.title: Principal Id

aic_version.description: AdaptiveInteractionContract version that was breached. Receivers MUST be on the same version (V-1) before applying enforcement; older/newer AICs imply a different rule set.
aic_version.title: Aic Version

offending_agent_id.description: DID or HTTPS URL of the agent that breached the AIC. The block is scoped to this agent.
offending_agent_id.title: Offending Agent Id

detected_by.description: Identifier (DID or URL) of the issuing orchestrator. Pairs with issuer_signature for authentication.
detected_by.title: Detected By

enforcement_actions.description: The actions the issuer applied locally; receivers SHOULD mirror those that are within their authority.
enforcement_actions.title: Enforcement Actions

block_duration_seconds.description: How long the block applies, measured from detected_at. Receivers MUST honour at least this duration.
block_duration_seconds.title: Block Duration Seconds

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 over a canonical, principal-data-free description of the violation (timestamps, AIC clause id, agent id, violation_type). Format: ``sha256:<hex>``. Lets auditors tie the notice to a stored evidence record without exposing principal content on the wire.
evidence_hash.title: Evidence Hash

issuer_signature.description: JWS (compact serialization) over the canonical JSON of this notice (excluding this field), signed by the issuing orchestrator's key. RECOMMENDED.
issuer_signature.title: Issuer Signature

schema.title: PACEViolationNotice

invariants: PCP-1: the PrincipalCapabilityProfile is stored on-device; no remote agent may write or modify it.
PCP-2: PCP versions are immutable and append-only; corrections are new versions.
PCP-3: a guardian declaring a PCP MUST be verifiably identified.
IM-1: an InteractionModality MUST be computed from the PCP before any interaction; an agent that cannot satisfy adaptations_required MUST escalate instead.

IM-1 channels: every channel a modality may use, primary and fallback, must reach the principal (no voice if she cannot hear, no text if she cannot see or read), be supported by the agent, and the fallback chain must end in guardian_relay or name an escalation target.

IM-2: an agent MUST use a language the PCP pins (adaptations_required language:<code>) or, without a pin, one listed at or above the AIC's min_language_fluency; otherwise it routes to a capable sub-agent or escalates, and never falls back to another language. An AIC MUST NOT bind a language the PCP rules out.
CCC-1: a ConsentCapacityCheck MUST precede any consent record for principals whose decision_capacity is fluctuating, limited, or guardian_required.
CCC-2: ConsentCapacityCheck results MUST NOT be transmitted to any remote agent.
CCC-3: a ConsentCapacityCheck is not a clinical assessment.

CCC-4: relay carries the question, not the consent: consent reached through a guardian relay requires a ConsentCapacityCheck of the principal that is not guardian_confirmed, unless decision_capacity is guardian_required.

AIC-1: no interaction outside valid_time_windows unless classified as emergency. Windows and the sundown block are the principal's local times in interaction_rules.timezone, whatever clock the agent runs on. No more than max_interactions_per_day contacts per principal, across all agents, per her local calendar day; emergencies are never blocked but are counted.
AIC-2: no more than max_options_per_turn options in a single turn.

AIC-3: after an unanswered attempt, no retry in the same window (non_response_policy.retry_delay = next_window); after non_response_policy.escalate_after non-responses the agent escalates to the guardian instead of trying again. escalate_after may not exceed max_retries + 1, so a principal is never dropped silently.

AIC-4: contract violations trigger the declared violation_policy; notify_guardian sends a GuardianNotification with both clocks and no capacity data, and cross-orchestrator blocks travel as signed PACEViolationNotice records.

AIC-5: an InteractionModality stays within the contract it was computed under: the contract's language, a timeout at least as long, speech no faster, no more options, no denser information, the required confirmation style and memory recap.
V-1: a receiver bound by the same aic_version for the principal MUST block offending_agent_id for at least block_duration_seconds.
V-2: receivers MUST NOT forward a PACEViolationNotice (one-hop broadcast).
V-3: receivers without an AIC for the principal log the notice but MUST NOT apply the block.

conformance.applies_to: Any agent that contacts the principal: reads her PCP copy, talks to her, asks for her consent.
The principal's own agent: keeps her PCP and contract, counts contacts across agents, relays through the guardian, enforces violations and talks to peer orchestrators.

notes.AIC-1: the daily limit, counted across every agent
